fields.description: Program Description 1. Teaching Objective​ Editor Notes: With basic knowledge learning and traning, students are to become professional in mechanical and electrical engineering and related fields. The students are trained with the basic theory of professionals in the field of mechanical and electrical engineering, mechanics, microelectronics, technology of power electronics, computer technology, basic knowledge of mechanical and electrical integration; Trained by senior engineers, students will obtain the basic ability to design, test and use of mechatronic products; Ability to make research and develop new electromechanical integration products; Ability to master the basic theories and skills of computer aided design, testing and manufacturing; The basic ability of technical and economic analysis and production organization and management of mechanical and electrical products. 2. Course Structure ​ Editor Notes: We can see both main courses and laboratory courses of Mechatronics Engineering among the four years. Course Name Credits Advanced Mathematics I 5.0 Advanced Mathematics II 5.0 Theoretical Mechanics 5.0 Material Michanics 4.5 Analog electronic circuits 4.0 Mechanism and Machine Theory 3.5 Single-chip Microcomputer Principle and Interface Technology of Mechatronics System 4.0 Machinery Design 3.5 Mechanical Manufacturing Engineering 3.0 Courses arrangements and credits as well as Laboratory Courses in detail.>> 3. Career and Internship Editor Notes: Students mainly become engineerings in related fields. Graduates can be the senior engineers engaged in the management of mechanical equipment; design of electronic and mechanical products; development and computer aided design of mechanical and electrical products. 4. School Introduction​ Editor Notes: SAU is a key university in Liaoning Province. Shenyang Aerospace University has developed into an academic Centre. SAU is proud of its practical teaching system which includes basic, professional and general practice. There are numerous first-rate labs for the students, some at national levels. Learn More >> 5. College of Mechanical Electrical Engineering​ Editor Notes: The College of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering boasts strong teaching ability and featured disciplines. College of Mechanical Electrical Engineering is one of the first professional Schools for training a large number of National Aviation Industry professionals and technical personnel, which made great contributions to the development of National defense engineering. The school has two master's degrees of machinery manufacturing and automation, mechanical design and theory (key supporting discipline of Liaoning Province), master of mechanical engineering and two levels of undergraduate degrees. 6. Facilities Editor Notes: SAU owns a number of advanced labs and research centres. The Key Laboratory of Experimental Center has a number of advanced equipments, including vertical machining center, precision EDM Machine, YAG laser processing machines, precision EDM, rapid prototyping machines and 10 sets high-level equipments. There are two key provincial laborites which can provide students more opportunities and facilities to make research in the colleague. 1) Electromechanical transmission and control lab This lab is equipped with five electromechanical transmission and control test beds typed with RTJLN-4 which offers students to take tests here. 2) PLC lab This lab is equipped with twenty-five comprehensive test equipments type with SAC-PLC/51 and two OU PENG 3D progress test-beds and two OU PENG 3D test beds which can simulate industrial environment. 7. Students Comments Editor Notes: Let's see what the international students say about their experience in SAU. I came here to get master's degree in field of Mechanical Engineering. When you are entering SAU for the first time, you are very impressed by the kind and friendly atmosphere, so I were, too. Staying here with people of different nations feel that you belong to the world. -- Ksenia Iakovleva, Russian Staying at SAU is the best experience that I ever have in my life. On behalf of Cambodian students I would like to invite more students from Cambodia to study in SAU. -- Reun Seyha, Cambodia My experience at SAU has grown to a whole new level especially in the area of learning to be independent and in cultivating a quality of independence. On the note, I feel positive that China is home away from home. -- Prajwo Lal Shrestha, Nepal 8. Faculty Editor Notes: SAU has a strong faculty, offering students most experienced courses. The teaching team of College of Mechanical Engineering are active in academic thinking and good overall quality. The main objective of the school is teaching promotes research, research promote teaching. In the past three years, a total of 60 research projects were undertaken and completed. Subject: Mechanical Design and Manufacture Professor Zhu Hu Doctor Degree in Seoul National University(1998-2004) Subject: Mechanical Manufacture Professor Wang Wei Executive director of China Aviation Society

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. * 2. Passport empty visa page * 3. Certification of no criminal record * 4. High school graduate certificate According to Liaoning Province Government requirement: graduate certificate in language other than Chinese should be translated into Chinese and be notarized. If you can not find translation organization, please contact counselor@cucas.cn. Graduation certificate must be notarized and translated into Chinese by the notary office in your country or China(For those who studied in China for previous education). * 5. High school academic transcript According to Liaoning Province Government requirement: academic transcript in language other than Chinese should be translated into Chinese and be notarized. If you can not find translation organization, please contact counselor@cucas.cn. Academic transcript must be notarized and translated into Chinese by the notary office in your country or China(For those who studied in China for previous education). * 6. Physical examination record for foreigner Physical examination record for foreigner * 7. 2 minutes Self-introduction video in English * 8. Passport first page * 9. English proficiency certificate TOFEL or IELTS certificate for the native language is Non-English students. * 10. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Under the age of 25, senior high school graduation or with equivalent qualification of 12-year education background. Mathematics, physics and chemistry with 60 of total marks results are necessary for engineering degree courses. 2. English competence certificates: -Applicants from countries where English is the official language are exempt from proof of English language proficiency. -The applicants that use English as the language of instruction at high school, may use the language certificate issued by the high school. -If the applicant does not meet any of above criteria, then IELTS or TOFELresult is preferred. -If the applicant cannot provide any English competence certificate mentioned above, SAU will evaluate the applicant's English level by checking the English self-introduction video and English result on the transcript. 3.
